Issue Title: [BUG] ToolUsage not using same I18N as Agent Description: ### Description The ToolUsage class defaults to using I18N() and has no way to update it. It should use the same I18N as the agent so that custom prompt_file's work properly. ### Steps to Reproduce 1. Make a new prompt file (like translation/en.json) and edit the `tool_usage_exception` message. 2. Set your crew to use this new prompt_file. 2. Have an agent use a tool incorrectly. 3. Observe that the error message sent to the AI does not contain the update from 1. ### Expected behavior The tool error message sent to the AI contains the updated wording from the prompt_file ### Screenshots/Code snippets I18N does not use a custom prompt_file. When ToolUsage is created, there is no way to set the prompt_file. ### Operating System macOS Sonoma ### Python Version 3.10 ### crewAI Version 0.70.1 ### crewAI Tools Version 0.12.1 ### Virtual Environment Conda ### Evidence Screenshots above show that the I18N never uses the prompt_file property set on the crew in ToolUsage and has no way of being set. ### Possible Solution When the ToolUsage is created, have it set its i18n to the same as the agent. I will open a PR for this. ### Additional context N/A

The search result shows the class ToolUsage defined in the file src/crewai/tools/tool_usage.py. It has an __init__ method and multiple other methods like parse, use, on_tool_error, on_tool_use_finished among others.

1. This part of the code (ToolUsage class) handles the usage of tools, likely within the context of an agent executing tasks. It manages the initialization with the tools and agent references and methods that deal with calling and parsing tool inputs and results.

2. The bug report specifically mentions that the ToolUsage class defaults to using a new I18N() instance and has no way to update it, leading to inconsistent localization (i.e., it should use the same I18N instance as the agent). This is relevant to the __init__ method since that is where such an I18N instance would likely be set or initialized. We need to check how I18N is being instantiated or used inside ToolUsage.

3. The intended behavior, given the issue description, is for the ToolUsage class to inherit or receive the same I18N instance as the agent to respect custom localizations from prompt_file settings. So, the __init__ should accept or set I18N from the agent and not instantiate its own default one.

This ensures ToolUsage uses the same localization setup as the agent, preserving existing functionality while enabling use of custom prompt_file localization updates.
